title: Executive Order 14375: Designating the Board of Peace as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain…
summary: Executive Order 14375, "Designating the Board of Peace as a Public International Organization Entitled To Enjoy Certain Privileges, Exemptions, and Immunities", was signed on 2026-01-16 and published in the Federal Register on 2026-01-22 (91 FR 2837).
